name: adgroup_learning_days
label_en: days of delivery before an ad group is past learning
label_zh: 广告组过了学习期所需的投放天数
explain: a new batch's group spends from the exploration wallet until it has delivered this long; platforms' own learning lasts about a week
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: adgroup_window_days
label_en: days an ad group's evidence is read over
label_zh: 读取广告组证据的天数
explain: two weeks smooth a week's rhythm; at an ad group's few conversions a week is too thin to judge
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: adgroup_judge_spend
label_en: spend an ad group needs in the window before it is judged
label_zh: 判断广告组前窗口内所需的花费
explain: the scale of an ad group of 20 to 50 a day, not of a campaign: a campaign's judging spend (ten times the doubt line) leaves every real ad group unjudged and none reaches the performance wallet; in an account whose currency is far from this scale a person sets it
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: adgroup_min_conversions
label_en: conversions an ad group needs in the window before it is judged
label_zh: 判断广告组前窗口内所需的最少转化数
explain: fewer is noise; the same floor as a campaign's, because the evidence is the same kind
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: adgroup_end_idle_days
label_en: days a stopped ad group sits idle before it is paid by nobody
label_zh: 已停广告组闲置多少天后不再分到预算
explain: a fortnight without delivery is over; a group stopped for less is still judged on its days
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client
